title: action send.private: data
description: Private message to a user. On platforms with features.private_messages=room (Camfrog) scope.room is required in practice: the PM goes through that room (connector answers not_in_room otherwise).

whisper.description: (1.1) A hub user's private whisper to this user. Never falls back to a room send: a user who is not present fails with not_found (details.code not_present). The text is never logged or remembered by the connector.

id.description: Whisper id at the hub; message.private.whisper.reply_to names it.
